name: Image-based Transfer Function Optimization via Automatic Differentiation
aliases: Image-based Transfer Function Optimization via DiffDVR
definition: A method to optimize transfer functions by directly minimizing the difference between rendered images of two volume fields. It uses automatic differentiation to propagate changes in the rendered image back to the transfer function parameters.
summary: Image-based Transfer Function Optimization via Automatic Differentiation matches rendered images of two volume datasets by minimizing pixel-level differences using gradient-based optimization, prioritizing visually significant voxels over per-voxel accuracy.
